# Day-by-Day Checklist

Companion to your master timeline. Check items off as you go. Word targets are guides, not hard caps — use them to stop yourself editing prematurely, 
not to cut yourself short.

Where a task depends on someone else (supervisor, Colin, the editor), it's flagged *(italic)* — the date is your best-case place-holder, not a promise; if it slips, 
move straight to the next unchecked item rather than waiting.

---
